page.title: Global configuration
page.description: Configure the client defaults for the active QA workspace.
page.descriptionShared: Configure the sentiment analyzer shared by all clients.

callAnalysis.title: Call analysis defaults
callAnalysis.description: How imported calls are transcribed and which analyses run on them.

banner.title: Active client configuration
banner.description: These defaults apply to every call imported for the client selected in your current QA session.

language.label: Transcription language
language.help: Auto-detect picks the language per call.

retention.label: Audio retention
retention.help: Audio files are deleted after this period; transcripts and scores stay.

diarization.label: Speaker diarization
diarization.help: Split the transcript into agent and customer turns.

analyses.label: Analyses to run
analyses.help: Every imported call goes through the selected analyses automatically.

minDuration.label: Minimum call duration
minDuration.help: Shorter calls are imported but not analysed.

masking.title: Sensitive data masking
masking.description: What is masked, for how long it can be revealed and the reveal log live in QA Manager → Settings → Privacy.

evaluation.title: Client evaluation configuration
evaluation.description: Choose the form and the evaluator agents used automatically for this client.

banner.title: Active client configuration
banner.description: This configuration applies only to the client selected in your current QA session.

evaluation.requirement: A default form, a primary evaluator and a fallback evaluator are required for QA campaigns to import UCXM conversations and run evaluations automatically.

format.label: Evaluation format
format.hint: Only one format can be active for automatic campaign evaluations.

fallback.label: Fallback evaluator
fallback.description: Used when the primary evaluator is not available.

history.title: Version history
history.description: Every saved evaluation configuration, newest first.

contextRules.title: Evaluator context rules
contextRules.description: Manage manual rules by topic and scope, or attach versioned Word protocols to a line of business.
contextRules.searchPlaceholder: Search by topic, target or context
contextRules.empty: No rules match the current filters

howRules.summary: Each rule covers one topic. In each topic the most specific level wins: campaign, then campaign type, then client ({{client}}).

bullets.one: Client rules are the default for every campaign.
bullets.two: A campaign-type rule on the same topic replaces the client rule for campaigns of that type.
bullets.three: A campaign rule on the same topic replaces both for that campaign only.

drawer.description: One topic, one level. The evaluator receives the context text when it scores a call in scope.
drawer.contextHelp: Written for the evaluator: what to look for and how to score it.

docs.title: Protocol documents
docs.description: Versioned Word protocols attached to a line of business.

previewDrawer.title: Effective context
previewDrawer.description: The rules an evaluator receives for one campaign after every level has been merged.
previewDrawer.empty: No active rules apply to this campaign.

campaignTypes.title: Campaign types
campaignTypes.description: Manage the client's campaign type catalogue used by campaign assignments and COPC question tags.
campaignTypes.empty: No campaign types match the current filters
campaignTypes.lockedHint: Built-in type, cannot be edited or deleted

drawer.description: The code is what campaigns and COPC forms refer to; it cannot change once created.
drawer.duplicate: A campaign type with this code already exists.
drawer.name: Name

delete.title: Delete campaign type
delete.message: Delete {{code}}? Campaigns assigned to it keep their history but lose the type.

naming.title: Audio import naming convention
naming.description: Describe how the filenames exported by this client's call center map onto the data we store on each conversation.

banner.title: Active client configuration
banner.configured: Imports are parsed with the convention below.
banner.missing: No default parser exists. Until a convention is saved, every audio import for this client is rejected.

naming.note: Saving replaces the full naming convention document and only affects future imports. Existing conversations are not modified.

preview.title: Live filename preview
preview.description: Edit or paste a real filename to test the current extraction rules. Nothing is saved.

sample.label: Example filename
sample.help: Use the generated example or paste a filename, including an optional -CODE suffix.

convention.title: Convention
convention.description: The separator, the order of the segments and how the date is read.
convention.duplicate: Each field can appear only once.

scoreScales.title: Score scales
scoreScales.description: Define named ranges, such as Low or Excellent, and use them in alert rules.

empty.title: No score scales found
empty.description: Create a scale or change the filters to see results.

drawer.description: Bands are read from the bottom up: each one starts at its floor and ends where the next begins.
drawer.bandsHelp: The first band always starts at 0; floors must climb.
drawer.label: Label
drawer.invalidBands: Every band needs a label and a floor higher than the previous one.

sentiment.notice: Saving creates and immediately activates an immutable version for new sentiment analyses.

instructions.title: Analyzer instructions
instructions.description: Define the model context and the rules for selecting a configured emotion for each participant.

systemPrompt.label: LLM system prompt
systemPrompt.help: Sets the analyzer's role and operating limits.

classification.label: Classification instructions
classification.help: Explains how the model should choose an emotion. The application derives the sentiment and must not ask the model for it.

catalog.title: Emotion catalogue
catalog.description: Manage the canonical emotion identifiers and map each one to a single fixed sentiment level.

causes.title: Root cause catalogue
causes.description: The causes of sentiment drops the analyzer can assign, with what the AI looks for in each. Saving creates a new version together with the prompts and emotions above.
causes.hint: Added causes cannot be deleted, only switched off per operation in Settings.
causes.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what in a call tells the AI this is the cause, with example situations or phrases
